# Captured pin-boundary inputs

These are inert, exact historical test inputs for the dependency-pin census.
The container and outer manifest keep their original bytes; no compiled code,
semantic proof or full historical packet is claimed by this fixture. The archive
contains captured source as data, including historical dependency spellings.
Tests copy selected members only into disposable adversarial repositories and
never build or fetch those historical dependencies.

- `source.tar.gz`: 74,686 bytes, SHA-256
  `311358d0bee8eaa5c692bd2aa1aee268e48d17311bb629848187d59413fecfba`.
- `artifact-manifest.json`: 22,567 bytes, SHA-256
  `e2083a87711b4fc2a63d63ce1eefaa62946b3c8ba7df82ac05c45feef2cfdb10`.

The production seal and original member paths, kinds, modes and checksums remain
mandatory. This source fixture needs no original repository history, network or
external artifact authority. The remaining historical packet stays separately
retained; these two files do not stand in for its observations or proofs.
